items.headline: Nvidia Vera Rubin sweeps MLPerf Training
items.summary: In results out on Monday, Vera Rubin NVL72 topped every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark, with up to twice the per-GPU speed of GB300 and near-linear scaling to 1,024 GPUs.

items.headline: Anthropic: Claude ported a model to AMD GPUs in about three days
items.summary: Ahead of Thursday's listing, Anthropic told investors a Claude Mythos preview did the porting work for one model on AMD's MI355X in roughly three days, against 6-12 months historically. The claim covers one model's prefill only.

items.headline: Microsoft puts a local coding model into GitHub Copilot
items.summary: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, a 138B-parameter mixture-of-experts model, can now run locally in Copilot on high-memory machines; Google also made Gemini in Apps Script generally available.

items.headline: Quiet in orbit; the Leonids are tonight's show
items.summary: No major new launches or discoveries confirmed overnight after last week's Starship Flight 15. The Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight into Wednesday, with a dark sky thanks to a young Moon.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, chase the gaps for the Leonids
items.summary: Met Éireann's Ulster forecast has clear spells and scattered showers tonight, lows of 2 to 6C and light winds, so milder than last night. The young crescent Moon sets early, leaving dark skies. Dark from about 17:30; for meteors, watch clear breaks after midnight, facing east. Verdict: mixed.

items.headline: GTA 6 launch week: two days to go
items.summary: Rockstar's game lands Thursday on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with still no PC date. Nothing new turned up on the Witcher, Cyberpunk or Borderlands watchlist.

items.headline: EA UFC 6 announces a PRIDE FC expansion for 11 December
items.summary: Long-requested PRIDE content is coming to EA UFC 6 next month; full details still to come.

items.headline: Quiet week so far; Polaris 40 on Saturday
items.summary: No major results since The Crown. Saturday's Polaris 40 in Southampton sees Garry Tonon back in jiu-jitsu competition.

items.headline: What's next for the UFC 334 winners
items.summary: After Gane retained heavyweight gold and Kayla Harrison submitted Amanda Nunes at MSG, attention turns to who each faces next; no Irish or UK fighters featured.

items.headline: UFC Qatar on Saturday: Prochazka vs Stirling
items.summary: Fight week in Doha, with unbeaten Navajo Stirling looking to leap into title contention at the former champion's expense.

items.headline: Hamilton reportedly seeking £50m from F1 and the FIA
items.summary: A report links the claim to a proposed major rule change; neither side has confirmed details, so treat it with some caution.

items.headline: Aston Martin and Williams dress up for Vegas
items.summary: Aston Martin has revealed a major one-off livery change and Williams a chrome tweak for Saturday night's race on the Strip.

items.headline: Lawson still waiting on Racing Bulls decision
items.summary: Liam Lawson's 2027 future remains unresolved, and the delay is drawing harsh verdicts. Quiet on the GT and endurance front.
